Union Minister Gadkari Challenges Claims About E20 Petrol Damaging Engines

Union Minister Nitin Gadkari has challenged those claiming that E20 petrol, which contains 20% ethanol, damages vehicle engines. He dared them to present any petrol vehicle damaged by E20 petrol, stating he would provide compensation if they could prove it. Gadkari also addressed concerns about mileage and the cost-effectiveness of E20 petrol, with the government responding to various questions on the matter. Some reports also discussed the potential for cheaper pure petrol if ethanol blending is not required.
